$Comment: The Great Turkey: Martha's way into the Turkey Graveyard. Beat the Great Turkey once in the graveyard
she opens for a Wishbone (ZiggfreedCommon/Dungeons/Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Graveyard.json), then report
back. The _Harvest_Feast folder makes the id harvest_feast_great_turkey. Martha offers it on her
graveyard_offer screen once Turkey Hunt is done, the quest that also opens Extra Turkeys, where
Wishbones come from; while it is carried her conversation opens on her graveyard screen, with the way
in, and once it is done on graveyard_ready, where the player hands it in.
ENCOUNTER_DEFEATED names the normal fight's script with MatchMode EXACT, so only the normal way in
counts (the hard way opens after this quest), and every player the fight credits counts the win;
only players carrying the quest when it falls move it. Npc.TurnInId, from the base, adds the
Collecting it is what opens the hard way in: Martha's enter_hard option asks for this quest in
Requires.Quests, which reads a finished and collected quest. Repeat.PerRun brings it back once in each
Harvest Feast. The hard way stays open from a past year's collected quest until the player takes it
again, and closes while it is carried; one left unfinished when the feast ends waits for the next. Its Claim pays Harvest Coins,
festival tokens, a Wishbone for the first hard run, favor with Martha and Festival Favor.
The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Defense XP for the fight, paid only where that mod runs. Its own
Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves the row out on a server without it, unpaid and
unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: Great_Turkey
